stage_definitions.raw_material: A basic agricultural, animal, seafood, or mineral ingredient with minimal processing.
stage_definitions.purchased_processed: An item normally purchased after commercial processing.
stage_definitions.in_house_prepared: An item mixed, cut, marinated, assembled, or otherwise prepared in the restaurant.
stage_definitions.portioned_raw: A raw product cut or weighed into a menu portion.
stage_definitions.ready_to_cook: An assembled or coated item awaiting cooking.
stage_definitions.cooked_component: A cooked item that may be served directly or used in another item.
stage_definitions.ready_to_serve: A final inventory or menu-use form requiring little or no further preparation.
stage_definitions.non_food_supply: A disposable or operating supply with no food-processing lineage.
stage_definitions.unresolved: An entry whose identity cannot be determined confidently from the original wording.

relationship_rules.parent_ids: Immediate ingredients or source products used to produce the item.
relationship_rules.conceptual_parent: The parent describes product lineage, even when processing occurs at a supplier.
relationship_rules.inventory_parent: The parent is likely stocked and transformed inside the restaurant.
relationship_rules.multiple_parents: Recipes and assembled products may have several parent ingredients.
